method: Each complete supplied prefix and both candidate token continuations were read individually; labels and one-sentence reasons were manually entered, with no lexical/regex classifier. Confidence refers to the label judgment, not either candidate being correct.

blindness.auxiliary_source_continuation_exposure: During schema inspection the complete first samples.jsonl record was printed, exposing S001 auxiliary source-next-token. S001 is explicitly U for unresolved lexical interpretation; the auxiliary was not used as correctness gold. S002-S100 were read through a filtered view excluding all auxiliary continuations.

scope_limitations: Fixed-prefix local next-token assessment only, not freely generated continuations or reasoning chains.
Neither reference top1 nor the source next token is treated as a correct answer.
F/W labels do not establish semantic equivalence or semantic losslessness; C/L do not establish task errors.
Unknown continuations and incomplete token fragments remain explicit U or uncertainty flags.
Sample comes only from the 876 disagreements with reference margin below 0.05, not all tokens or all 1053 disagreements.
No Root annotations or subjective classifications were consulted.
